title: The Steaming Pool
text: A hot spring steams in the rocks, clear and warm as blood, in a place so cold the breath freezes on the lips. Moss grows green around its edge. Each Scion can take a moment in it, or keep watch on the dark around.

options.label: Sink into the warm water and let the cold go out of you.

outcomes.text: The heat sinks into the bones and draws the aches out.
Something in the water was waiting for a warm body.

options.label: Keep watch on the dark while the others rest.

outcomes.text: Nothing comes, but they learn a great deal about the dark from watching it.
